purpose: Teach: ひっかかっ/手ごろ/めでたし/微塵/多けれ/ともども/気長/なめらか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのスカーフが枝にひっかかったのよ
lines.en: Sho, my scarf got caught on a branch.
lines.style: Light, wry amusement. Held tone on the frustration — not complaining, just observing the small inconvenience with affection. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんのお店の絵、手ごろな価格で買えるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, you can get paintings from your shop at really good prices.
lines.style: Bright, earnest enthusiasm. Rushes slightly on the good news. Simple directness — he wants her to know something nice. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本の結末が「めでたし」だと安心するわね
lines.en: Sho, it's so comforting when a picture book ends with 'happily ever after.'
lines.style: Warm, reflective, speaking to something true she's noticed about him. Soft pace. Like she's both observing and validating something tender about the way he sees things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんへの感謝、微塵も忘れてないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I haven't forgotten even a bit of how grateful I am to you.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Earnest, not performing — stating something he knows to be true about himself. Steady eye contact. Small voice but anchored.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達が多ければ多いほど楽しいわよね
lines.en: Sho, the more friends you have, the more fun everything becomes.
lines.style: Gently reflective, speaking from experience. Unhurried. Like she's sharing something she's learned. Warm without insistence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママともども来てよかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really glad Mom and I came with you.
lines.style: Bright, straightforward gratitude. Light and genuine — no performance. Quick little smile in the voice. The easy honesty of a child who's happy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵の練習は気長にやっていきましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's take our time with your art practice — there's no rush.
lines.style: Gentle encouragement without pressure. Patient rhythm. Like she's giving him permission to grow slowly. Steady, reassuring presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵筆を、なめらかに動かせるようになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can move my brush more smoothly now.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Not boasting — just truthfully reporting progress he's noticed. Small but genuine. The satisfaction of small mastery clearly in his voice.
